resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 604 ft (184 m); OpenStreetMap tags ele 174. The record keeps the Register figure and notes the OpenStreetMap difference.

notes_for_editor: Single substantive source: the NHLR detail page has no visit report, condition note or staffing answer. The brief's status standing is not confirmed by any source read, so status is left out of facts. County check: the NHLR Location field reads Evergreen, Autauga County, Alabama, confirmed on the page 2026-10-09. A web search described Evergreen as the seat of Conecuh County, but that came from a search snippet, not a page read, so it is not cited. Two web searches found no Autauga County fire tower record. The Forest Lookouts (easternuslookouts.weebly.com) Evergreen page returns 404 and its Alabama list omits Evergreen. Thomas Kaufmann's 1819 News column is general about Alabama towers and is not used for this tower's condition. The story does not call the NHLR tower steel: that word comes only from the column's general remark about the MC-39 model. No photos added. Not verified: build details beyond 1949, fire history, staffing, current condition, access, fate.
